# Sirwan Afifi — Personal Engineering Journal

> Sirwan Afifi is a UK-based senior software engineer. This site contains his writing about web engineering, developer tooling, AI agents, and practical technology experiments in English, Farsi, and Kurdish.

Use the developer resources for the public read-only API. Content pages support explicit Markdown URLs and, when the Cloudflare edge Worker is active, `Accept: text/markdown` on their canonical URLs. No account or API key is required.

## When to Use This Site

Use this site when an agent needs Sirwan Afifi's published perspective on practical software engineering, React and TypeScript, developer tooling, AI-assisted development, or personal technology experiments. Use the writing indexes to find source articles, the Markdown variants to quote or summarise a page, and the versioned JSON API to enumerate public posts or resolve canonical URLs. Do not use this site as live product support, private data, medical or financial guidance, or a write-capable service.

- [Privacy notice](https://sirwan.info/privacy.md): Hosting, local preferences, third-party content, and email handling.
- [Complete sitemap](https://sirwan.info/sitemap-index.xml): Canonical crawl index for every public page.

## Recent Writing

- [A Dev-Only Permission Inspector Built on React Fiber](https://sirwan.info/blog/en/permission-inspector-react-fiber.md): A small dev-only inspector that links each permission check back to the DOM element it gated, using React 19's internals behind one adapter.
- [TIL: Kotlin's Generics Syntax Is a Pragmatic Compiler Trade-off](https://sirwan.info/blog/en/kotlin-generics-syntax.md): Kotlin's familiar generics syntax like foo<String>() isn't trivial, it's a deliberate parser compromise inspired by C#
- [TIL: Using Homebridge to Add Non-HomeKit Devices to Apple Home](https://sirwan.info/blog/en/homebridge.md): How to use Homebridge to connect non-HomeKit devices like the Levoit air purifier to Apple Home
